formation.title: The Crowns of the Danube
formation.text:
It is done. The hereditary lands, the Crown of Saint Wenceslas and the Crown of Saint Stephen have walked out of the Holy Roman Empire together, and the imperial dignity has been laid down. The electors meet without us; the Pope's legates ride for Vienna with grievances; in the German lands the Reich is left to the princes. We have what no Emperor bound to the Reichstag could ever hold: Austria, Bohemia and Hungary as one sovereign realm, answerable to no diet but our own court.

But a realm of Germans, Czechs, Magyars, Croats, Slovaks and a dozen more is not yet a monarchy. What binds it?

Antemurale Christianitatis makes the Danube the shield of Christendom: the Military Frontier, the Grenzer soldier-colonies, the endless Ottoman war that gives every crown a common enemy and a common cause.

Gesamtmonarchie makes the Danube one body: the Hofkammer, the Hofkriegsrat, the Pragmatic Sanction welding three chanceries into a single obedient administrative state.

This choice unlocks a destiny path in the Traditions tab.

options.text: Antemurale Christianitatis: be the bulwark of Christendom

modifiers.name: Antemurale Christianitatis
modifiers.text: The shield of Christendom on the Danube. The Military Frontier and the Grenzer soldier-colonies make the realm a wall of men against the Ottomans, and standing as the bulwark of the faith wins prestige across Catholic Europe, at the cost of a court forever tied up provisioning the frontier.

options.text: Gesamtmonarchie: weld three crowns into one body

modifiers.name: Gesamtmonarchie
modifiers.text: The total monarchy. The Hofkammer, the Hofkriegsrat and the Pragmatic Sanction weld three crowns into one obedient administrative body, taxed and integrated from Vienna, at the cost of the estates' and the imperial diet's resentment of the centralizing court.

advances.name: Bella Gerant Alii
advances.text: "Let others wage war; you, happy Austria, marry." Burgundy, Castile, Bohemia and Hungary all came to the House of Habsburg by inheritance and marriage, not conquest. Dynastic diplomacy is the founding instrument of the Danube state.

advances.name: The Vienna Hofkammer
advances.text: The central Court Chamber, founded 1527, pulled the Lower Austrian, Tyrolean, Bohemian and Hungarian treasuries into one hand in Vienna: the first financial spine of the composite monarchy. Unlocks the Hofkammer.

advances.name: The Hofkriegsrat
advances.text: The Court War Council of 1556, the first standing central military administration in Europe: it planned the Ottoman war, built the fortresses and paid the army of three crowns from one office.

advances.name: The Hungarian Huszar
advances.text: The light horse of the Hungarian crown, raised against Ottoman akinci raiders and copied by every army in Europe by 1700. Unlocks the Hungarian Huszar levy.

advances.name: The Danube Staple
advances.text: Vienna's medieval Stapelrecht forced every boat on the river to break cargo and trade at the imperial seat: the institution that turned the Danube into a single commercial artery. Unlocks the Donau-Stapel.

advances.name: The Militaergrenze
advances.text: The Military Frontier: Serb, Croat and Vlach colonists settled the Sava-Drava line under hereditary tenure for perpetual border service. Unlocks the Frontier district and the Grenzer levy.

event.title: The Military Frontier
event.text: Along the Sava, the Drava and the lower Danube a new kind of society takes shape. Serb, Croat and Vlach families are settled on the border under hereditary land tenure: free of feudal dues, free in their faith, but bound man and boy to perpetual military service. The Militaergrenze is not a fortress line but a living wall of soldier-farmers, the largest militarized population in Europe, watching the Ottoman frontier from cradle to grave. The question is what to do with a standing army that never disbands.

options.text: A spearhead: press the line south into Ottoman lands

modifiers.name: Frontier Spearhead
modifiers.text: The Military Frontier turned outward: the Grenzer as a spear of reconquest pressing the Ottoman line south.

options.text: A shield: settle the line deep and let it sustain itself

modifiers.name: Frontier Shield
modifiers.text: The Military Frontier settled deep and self-sustaining, an unbreakable wall that feeds and mans itself.

advances.name: The Kleinkrieg Doctrine
advances.text: The small war of the borderland: ambush, raid and skirmish across the broken Danube terrain, the irregular craft that made the Grenzer, hajduks and pandurs feared from the Sava to the Banat.

advances.name: The Confessional Border
advances.text: The Counter-Reformation pressed up the Danube on the back of the Jesuit colleges of Vienna, Graz, Olomouc and Tyrnau, which re-Catholicized and educated the recovered crowns. Unlocks the Jesuit College.

advances.name: The Donau-Flottille
advances.text: The imperial Danube war flotilla: the Tschaike galleys that fought the Ottoman river fleet from Komorn to Belgrade. Unlocks the Tschaike levy.

advances.name: The Renewed Constitution
advances.text: The Verneuerte Landesordnung of 1627: after the White Mountain the Bohemian crown was made hereditary Habsburg, Catholic and German-administered, and the elective monarchy abolished. The composite monarchy's foundational act of centralization.

event.title: The White Mountain
event.text: On a November morning outside Prague the army of the Bohemian Estates is broken in a single afternoon. The Winter King flees; twenty-seven leaders of the revolt are executed on the Old Town Square; the elective monarchy of Saint Wenceslas is abolished by the Verneuerte Landesordnung and the crown declared hereditary, Catholic and Habsburg. A third of Bohemia's land changes hands. No single day did more to forge the composite monarchy, or left a deeper wound in it.

options.text: Re-Catholicize by patent: one faith, imposed from above

modifiers.name: Verneuerte Landesordnung
modifiers.text: The Bohemian church and constitution remade by imperial patent, the Counter-Reformation imposed from above.

options.text: Bind a new nobility: loyalty bought with confiscated land

modifiers.name: Loyal Aristocracy
modifiers.text: A new service nobility bound to the crown with the confiscated estates of the White Mountain rebels.

advances.name: The Habsburg Kuerassier
advances.text: The steel-breasted heavy household cavalry, the decisive shock arm of the Imperial army from Luetzen to the Ottoman field. Unlocks the Kuerassier levy.

advances.name: The Standing Imperial Army
advances.text: The kaiserliche Armee: the first permanent multi-national standing army on the continent, paid from the Hofkammer and drilled by the Hofkriegsrat. Unlocks the Imperial Arsenal.

advances.name: Erblande Mercantilism
advances.text: The cameralist development of the hereditary lands: the Linz wool manufactory, the Idrija mercury, the Styrian iron of the Erzberg shipped down the Danube to the markets of the realm.

advances.name: The Pragmatic Sanction
advances.text: The decree of 1713, ratified crown by crown: the Habsburg lands shall descend indivisibiliter ac inseparabiliter as one body to a single heir. The constitutional spine of the Gesamtmonarchie.

event.title: The Pragmatic Sanction
event.text: Charles VI has no son, and he will not let the work of two centuries be partitioned at his death. Crown by crown, diet by diet, the Pragmatic Sanction is ratified: the Habsburg lands shall descend indivisibiliter ac inseparabiliter (indivisible and inseparable) as one body to a single heir, daughter or son. For the first time Austria, Bohemia and Hungary are not three crowns in one hand but one legal person. It is the constitutional spine of the Gesamtmonarchie. It is also the document the next war will be fought over.

options.text: One realm, one heir, indivisible and inseparable

modifiers.name: Indivisible Realm
modifiers.text: The Pragmatic Sanction ratified crown by crown: the Habsburg lands one legal body, one inheritance, one loyalty.

advances.name: The Theresian Reforms
advances.text: The reform that followed the loss of Silesia: a unified treasury, the Directorium and the conscription cantons turned the composite monarchy into an administrative machine.

event.title: The Theresian Reforms
event.text: Silesia is lost, and the loss is a verdict: a realm that cannot tax and cannot drill cannot defend itself. From Vienna the reform comes down like a tide: a unified treasury, the Directorium, the conscription cantons, the Theresianum to train the men who will run it. Where Maria Theresa builds the machine, Joseph II pushes it past its limits: the Toleranzpatent, a single chancery language, the serf set free by decree. For one generation the composite monarchy is, very nearly, a state.

options.text: The cameralist machine: taxed, drilled, centrally ruled

modifiers.name: The Theresian Machine
modifiers.text: The cameralist reform of Maria Theresa: a unified treasury, the Directorium, the conscription cantons: the composite monarchy run as a single state.

options.text: The Josephine reach: tolerance, literacy, one bureaucracy

modifiers.name: The Josephine Reach
modifiers.text: The enlightened reach of Joseph II: the Toleranzpatent, a single chancery language, a literate multi-ethnic bureaucracy.

advances.name: The Theresianum
advances.text: The cameral academy founded in Vienna in 1746 to train the multi-ethnic bureaucracy of the Gesamtmonarchie in a single administrative hand and a single chancery language. Unlocks the Theresianum.

advances.name: The Banat Colonization
advances.text: The Schwabenzuege: the great resettlement of the reconquered, depopulated Banat and Backa with Danube-Swabian colonists after the Treaty of Passarowitz, restoring a wasted frontier to cultivation.

advances.name: The Liechtenstein Artillery
advances.text: The artillery reform of Prince Joseph Wenzel of Liechtenstein: a standardized, mobile gun system that made the Imperial train the best-served artillery in Europe. Unlocks the Artillery Train levy.

advances.name: The Konzivilisation
advances.text: The regular-line conversion of the Frontier regiments: the Grenzer remade as drilled European infantry, something between light and line, valued in every theatre of the Imperial wars.

advances.name: The United Court Chancellery
advances.text: The Vereinigte Hofkanzlei: the attempt to fuse the Austrian and Bohemian chanceries into one administrative organ, the high-water mark of the centralizing project.

advances.name: Danube Steam Navigation
advances.text: The Erste Donau-Dampfschiffahrts-Gesellschaft, the steamship company that turned the river into the spine of a single industrial Danubian economy from Regensburg to the Iron Gates. Unlocks the Danube Steam Yard.

destiny.name: The Danubian Destiny
destiny.text: Three crowns are forged into one realm; what the realm becomes is not yet decided. The founding choice (the bulwark of Christendom or the total monarchy) opens a path that the dynasty will spend its centuries walking.

conditions.text: The union holds itself together (Stability at least 75)

event.title: The Destiny of the Danube
event.text: The realm is forged and the founding choice is made. From here the road is long: the dynasty will spend the centuries of its reign making good on what was chosen at the founding. The court understands the work ahead, and the goals by which it will be measured.

options.text: Let the work begin

destiny.name: The Long Turkish War
destiny.text: Press the Ottoman frontier back to the Sava-Danube confluence: hold Belgrade and rebuild it as a fortress town, and take Smederevo, the keys to the river line Eugene of Savoy would one day hold (Antemurale path).

conditions.text: Founding path: Antemurale Christianitatis, the bulwark of Christendom
The Frontier is built, and Belgrade answers to Vienna, not Constantinople (the destiny root is taken)
Belgrade is held by the crown and has at least 32 development
Own Smederevo, or a subject owns it

event.title: The Frontier Restored
event.text: Belgrade and Smederevo are ours, and the Sava-Danube confluence with them. The frontier stands where Eugene of Savoy would one day draw it: not a fortified line on a map but a recovered country, the gateway from which any further war against the Porte must be launched. The army that did this does not stand down.

options.text: The river line is held

destiny.name: The Drive Into the Balkans
destiny.text: Carry the Grenzer spearhead past the rivers into the Ottoman interior: Niš on the Morava, Skopje on the Vardar, and Sofia behind the Balkan range. The bulwark turned offensive.

conditions.text: The small war carries the Grenzer past the rivers, into the Morava and Vardar valleys (the Sava Line is held)
Own Skopje, or a subject owns it
Own Niš, or a subject owns it
Own Sredets, or a subject owns it

event.title: Across the Rivers
event.text: The spearhead has carried past the rivers into the Ottoman interior. The Morava valley, Skopje on the Vardar, Sofia behind the Balkan range: the bulwark is no longer a shield but a blade pressed into the heart of Rumelia. How the war is now waged will decide how far the blade reaches.

options.text: Storm the fortress belt: siege and reduce the strongholds

modifiers.name: Breaker of Walls
modifiers.text: The fortress-storming army of the Balkan offensive: quick to seize the initiative, long in its reach, and hardened by the tradition won in every breach.

options.text: The Grenzer way: a war of movement, raid and pursuit

modifiers.name: The Grenzer Tide
modifiers.text: The war of movement and raid carried into the Ottoman interior, the borderers swift and pursuing, though a war fought on the move loosens the crown's grip on the countryside it crosses.

destiny.name: The Eastern Crusade
destiny.text: The bulwark becomes the conqueror: take the Danubian principalities at Bucharest and Târgoviște, carry the war to Constantinople itself, and leave the Sultan's state broken or kneeling to Vienna. Unlocks the Antemurale Bastion.

conditions.text: The Sultan's throne stands empty or answers to Vienna: the Balkan drive is complete, and the Ottoman state no longer exists or is our subject
Own Bucharest, or a subject owns it
Own Târgoviște, or a subject owns it
Own Constantinople, or a subject owns it

event.title: The Sword of Christendom
event.text: Bucharest, Târgoviște, and the walls of Constantinople itself. The work of the bulwark is complete: the Danubian Monarchy is the sword that finally turned the Ottoman tide, the foremost Catholic power of the East. What is made of so total a victory?

options.text: The crowned bulwark: standing across all Christendom

modifiers.name: The Sword of Christendom
modifiers.text: The bulwark crowned: the diplomatic reach of the foremost Catholic power of the East, its army's hard-won renown enduring, its prestige slow to fade.

options.text: The conquering host: an army that lives off its conquests

modifiers.name: The Conquering Host
modifiers.text: An army that recruits and replenishes from the lands it takes and garrisons what it holds: the engine of a sustained eastern war.

destiny.name: The Cameral Foundation
destiny.text: Centralization measured in offices, not conquest: govern through central councils, as the court ordinance of 1527 did over all the Habsburg crowns, and set the Kameralhoheit, the Vienna fisc's own bureaucracy, actually running (Gesamtmonarchie path).

conditions.text: Founding path: Gesamtmonarchie, the total centralized monarchy
The Hofkammer's writ actually runs (the destiny root is taken and the Kameralhoheit bureaucracy is active)
Has the policy Central Council

event.title: The Cameral Foundation
event.text: No army won this. The new administrative learning of the age (the bank, the standing professional army, the surveyed and developed land) has been drawn into the realm and the offices built to carry it. The Gesamtmonarchie now has a spine of paper and ledger rather than of garrisons.

options.text: The offices are built

destiny.name: The United Treasury
destiny.text: The Hofkammer made absolute: the Vienna Court Chamber established over three crowns, the silver of the Carpathian mines flowing into a single fisc, and Vienna's staple market grown into a merchants' quarter.

conditions.text: Silver moves through a crown fisc, not three (the Cameral Foundation is laid)
A market the country is in

children.text: Silver is produced in the market
Silver is traded in the market

conditions.text: Vienna is ours and has merchants quarters or a larger market

event.title: The United Treasury
event.text: The Hofkammer is made absolute: one treasury over three crowns, a full war chest, the silver of Kremnica and the Erzberg iron flowing into a single fisc. The composite monarchy is becoming, for the first time, a single economic body. How is the new wealth to be held?

options.text: The crown fisc: revenue drawn straight into the centre

modifiers.name: The Crown Fisc
modifiers.text: Revenue drawn straight into the central treasury: the gold of the Carpathian mines and the estate tax of three crowns, though a fisc-first crown skimps on the upkeep of its gun train.

options.text: The Danube market: the river as one integrated economy

modifiers.name: The Danube Market
modifiers.text: The river welded into one integrated commercial body: the staple economy of three crowns, its merchants and trade centres carrying a single Danubian market.

destiny.name: The Total Monarchy
destiny.text: The apex of the centralizing project: a stable, literate, single-administered Danube state, with both the fiscal and the confessional pillar, the Kameralhoheit and the Reformationskommission, running at once. Unlocks the Staatskanzlei. (The dual-monarchy compromise is not reached here: that reckoning belongs to the Nationalities Question.)

conditions.text: The fisc and the confessional commission both answer to one hand (the United Treasury is complete; the Kameralhoheit and Reformationskommission bureaucracies are both active)
Stability at least 25
Average country literacy at least 30

event.title: The Total Monarchy
event.text: The project reaches its apex: a wealthy, stable, literate, enlightened realm administered from one hand, the estates bound into the machine rather than ranged against it. The Danube state is, for one generation, very nearly a single modern monarchy. The compromise of nationalities is a reckoning still to come; this is the centralizing instrument that must precede it.

options.text: The cameralist hand: the estates welded into the machine

modifiers.name: The Cameralist Hand
modifiers.text: The estates bound into the machine rather than against it: the crown's grip on the realm does not slip and the bureaucratic apparatus runs cheap.

effects.name: Head of the Cabinet Promotion Cost Modifier

options.text: The enlightened state: literate, surveyed, single-ruled

modifiers.name: The Enlightened State
modifiers.text: A literate, surveyed, single-administered realm: the Josephine school carried to its conclusion, the new learning of the age cheap to embrace.

destiny.name: The Josephine Triumph
destiny.text: One patent, one code, from the Vltava to the Tisza: the uniform administrative state completed where Joseph II's historical programme was fought to a draw, and what the United Chancellery only attempted, finished. Impossible for a crown that has already lost a constituent kingdom. Unlocks the Uniform Patent reform.

conditions.text: The third stage of either path is complete: the Eastern Crusade or the Total Monarchy
One patent, one code, from the Vltava to the Tisza (the Directorium bureaucracy is active and no constituent kingdom has been lost)

event.title: The Patent Enforced
event.text: The couriers carry the same document to every chancery from the Vltava to the Tisza, and for the first time in the realm's history, every chancery files it the same way. One code, one language of administration, one crown behind both. What Joseph's generation decreed and the estates refused has been made to hold. The House of Austria, which forged its own electoral dignity when the Reich denied it one, has now forged something the Reich never managed: a state that answers with one voice.

options.text: One patent, one code, one crown

destiny.name: The Estates Endure
destiny.text: The other answer to the same question: the Golden Bull's right to be asked, formalized instead of abolished. The Landstaende, the estate assemblies' own apparatus, must be the one actually running. Unlocks the Diet in Council reform.

conditions.text: The third stage of either path is complete: the Eastern Crusade or the Total Monarchy
The Landtags keep their old right to be asked (the Landstaende bureaucracy is active)

event.title: The Old Rights Kept
event.text: The diets sit in council: not as supplicants received at the crown's pleasure, but as an organ of the constitution itself. The old right to be asked, which other courts spent the age abolishing, has been kept and formalized: the crown legislates with the Landtags, not past them. The House of Austria has concluded that a realm of many nations holds together longest when each of them is, on the record, consulted.

options.text: The crown asks; the Landtags answer

units.name: Hungarian Huszar
units.text: The light horse of the Hungarian crown: fast, far-ranging raiders born of the Ottoman border war, plundering and screening at a pace no heavy cavalry could match.

units.name: Grenzer
units.text: Military Frontier soldier-colonists. Serb, Croat and Vlach borderers, masters of ambush and skirmish on the broken Sava-Drava terrain, fighting light and living off little.

units.name: Tschaike
units.text: The shallow-draft river galley of the Danube war flotilla, crewed by the Tschaikisten, that fought the Ottoman fleet from Komorn down to Belgrade.

units.name: Habsburg Kuerassier
units.text: The steel-breasted heavy household cavalry, the decisive shock arm of the Imperial army: a charge of armoured nobility delivered at the breaking point of the line.

units.name: Liechtenstein Artillery Train
units.text: The standardized, mobile Imperial gun system of the Liechtenstein reform, the best-served artillery in Europe by the Napoleonic wars. Its light carriages keep pace with the infantry.

buildings.name: Hofkammer
buildings.text: The central Court Chamber, Vienna 1527: the treasury that pulled the chambers of every crown into one hand. The financial spine of the Gesamtmonarchie.

effect_groups.label: To the country, when built in the capital

buildings.name: Donau-Stapel
buildings.text: The Danube staple house, where Vienna's Stapelrecht forced every boat on the river to break cargo and trade, making the river one commercial artery.

buildings.name: Militaergrenze
buildings.text: A Military Frontier district: soldier-colonist settlements under hereditary land tenure for perpetual border service, the largest militarized society in early modern Europe.

buildings.name: Jesuit College
buildings.text: A college of the Society of Jesus (Vienna, Graz, Olomouc, Tyrnau), the engine of the Counter-Reformation and the school of the recovered crowns.

buildings.name: Imperial Arsenal
buildings.text: The kaiserliches Zeughaus: the central armoury and foundry of the standing Imperial army, casting the cannon and storing the muskets of three crowns.

effect_groups.label: To the country, when built in the capital

buildings.name: Theresianum
buildings.text: The cameral academy of Vienna, 1746, that trained the multi-ethnic bureaucracy of the composite monarchy in a single administrative hand.

effect_groups.label: To the country, when built in the capital

buildings.name: Danube Steam Yard
buildings.text: A works of the Danube Steam Navigation Company, turning the river into the spine of a single industrial Danubian economy from Regensburg to the Iron Gates.

buildings.name: Antemurale Bastion
buildings.text: The great frontier fortress-arsenal of the bulwark of Christendom: the Peterwardein- and Belgrade-class star fort with its magazine, the hinge on which the whole Ottoman war turns.

buildings.name: Staatskanzlei
buildings.text: The State Chancery: the central organ of the total monarchy, the apparatus that drafts, files and administers the whole realm from a single hand. The instrument of centralization: not of the compromise that may one day follow it.

list.name: Kameralhoheit
list.text: When Ferdinand I made the Vienna Hofkammer independent of the Aulic Council in 1527 he folded the Lower Austrian, Tyrolean, Bohemian and Hungarian land-chambers under one fisc; Maria Theresa raised it to the supreme authority for finance, mining and commerce. Revenue the crown-land estates had once voted and audited was now assessed from Vienna: a fisc that captures mining and trade for the crown, but one that decays into rent-seeking clerks and a debased coinage when the chamber is starved.

list.name: Geheime Konferenz
list.text: Under Leopold I a handful of trusted magnates, the Conferenzminister, formed the inner cabinet that actually decided war, peace and dynastic policy, its secretaries drawn from the Austrian and Imperial chancelleries. Fast and secret, it bound the high aristocracy to the dynasty and bypassed the wider Privy Council entirely, but it was a closed door to the towns, and when neglected it curdles into a faction nest that stalls all cabinet work.

list.name: Grenz-Generalat
list.text: From the Bruck congress of 1578 the Inner Austrian lands financed a permanent cordon; the Karlovac and Varazdin generalates ran a society of Serb, Croat and Vlach soldier-colonists under hereditary tenure, tax-exempt and tolerated, in exchange for lifelong border service. A self-feeding wall of free militiamen answerable to Vienna and not to any seigneur, but an unpaid, ungoverned frontier turns to plunder and desertion. Requires the Military Frontier.

conditions.text: Has advance The Militaergrenze

list.name: Landstaende der Erblande
list.text: The separate Austrian, Bohemian and Hungarian Court Chancelleries in Vienna each preserved their crown's law, language and Landtag; the diets continued to vote taxes and recruits and to guard noble privilege against absolutist pressure, the Hungarian comitatus most stubbornly of all. Consent flows when the estates are honoured and legislation passes through the diets; neglected, the diets obstruct, war must be wrung out of them, and the composite drifts apart.

list.name: Directorium in publicis et cameralibus
list.text: After Aix-la-Chapelle, Friedrich Wilhelm von Haugwitz fused the Austrian and Bohemian chancelleries into one body for public affairs and finance in 1749, curtailed the crown-land diets and imposed a uniform decennial tax recess over the hereditary lands. The institutional engine of the Gesamtmonarchie: one administration over many crowns, the populations assimilated into a single state; but a half-built uniform state is only a heavier paperwork burden and a seething dispossessed nobility. Requires the United Court Chancery.

conditions.text: Has advance The United Court Chancellery

list.name: Reformationskommission
list.text: Ferdinand II's patents of 1624-27 permitted only the Catholic faith in Bohemia and Inner Austria; the religious commissions expelled Protestant clergy while the Jesuits, with Peter Pazmany on the Hungarian side, monopolized higher education and re-Catholicized the recovered lands. Confessional unity schooled a loyal clerical elite and fed dynastic legitimacy, but a coercive apparatus without the colleges to back it merely breeds resentment in the towns and a hostile coalition abroad. Requires a Catholic ruler.
